question: BrahMos supersonic missile is a joint venture between _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**India and Russia.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **BrahMos** is a joint venture between India's **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) **and **NPO Mashinostroyenia of Russia. **
 
• The** name Brahmos **is a portmanteau formed from the names of two rivers, the** Brahmaputra of India** and the **Moskva (river) of Russia.**
 
• **Brahmos** Missile is manufactured by** The BrahMos Aerospace Private Limited,** headquartered in **New Delhi, India.**
 
• The **BrahMos** is a medium-range ramjet **supersonic cruise missile** that can be launched from submarines, ships, aircraft, or land.
 
• It is notably one of the fastest supersonic cruise missiles.
